definitions.explanation: To raise oneself from a lying or sitting position to standing.
To raise one's upper body from a lying position to a sitting position.

definitions.gloss: to recover, to get back up
definitions.explanation: To recover from a setback or difficulty (figurative use).

notes:
{起|お}き{上|あ}がる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to get up or rise.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ (to get up) + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to rise) → to rise up

ASPECT (ている):
{起|お}き⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being up (having risen).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ベッド→ベッド：04501_beddo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (get up from bed)
- ⟦{倒|たお}れても→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (get back up even when knocked down)
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{起|お}き{上|あ}がる (slowly get up)

RELATED WORDS:
- {起|お}き⟦{上|あ}がり→上がり：25038_agari⟧こぼし: a roly-poly toy (tumbler doll that always rights itself)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to wake up, to get up (more general)
- {起|お}き{上|あ}がる emphasizes the physical motion of rising
